Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, complainant and learned A.P.P appearing on behalf of the State.
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
At the very outset, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the complainant has submitted that processes under Section 82 Cr.PC has been issued against the petitioner.
Hence, the present anticipatory bail application is Patna High Court CR.

. 
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that there is no specific assertion regarding mode of payment of alleged Rs. 11,82,000/- in the complaint petition against the petitioner.
After hearing both the parties, it transpires that the aforesaid facts regarding issuance of processes under Section 82 Cr.P.C finds mentioned in the impugned order.

Taking into considering the facts aforesaid, the petitioner is directed to surrender before learned Shiv Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47883026/
